The proposed fix

pricing.py
def discounted(price, percent):- return price+ return price * (1 - percent / 100)

The challenge

Can diverse wrong fixes also pass?

Not started
3 semantic counterfeits · state / boundary / partialabs(price) · max(price, 0) · skip discount for credits
Stronger test discovereddiscounted(-100, 20) must equal -80
Accepted with evidence

The correct fix passed. Three diverse counterfeits failed the new negative-credit test.

3/3 killed · high confidence

What just happened?

Why was the first test weak?It checked only a normal positive price, so three different credit-handling mistakes escaped.
What did PatchTrial challenge?Sign loss, zero-clamping, and a partial implementation that skipped discounts for credits.
Why accept now?The correct fix passes while all three valid, diverse counterfeits fail. Quantity and diversity both count toward confidence.
